utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Last I heard, they’re still shooting for Saturday morning, around 10-ish at the community center lot, but it’s not fully pinned down yet. If I hear anything firmer, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—that helps. I’m still keeping safety repairs like space heaters and lamps at the top, and tomorrow I’m comparing our list with Jules’s so we can lock things in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds smart, Mara—I’ve been hearing the same Saturday morning plan, so once you and Jules line it up, I can keep spreading the word around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 9 by the community center lot, right? I’m bringing my toolkit and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Close—it’s Rosa organizing, and it starts Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot. Bring the toolkit and cords though, that’ll be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, got it—Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot then. I’ll still bring the toolkit and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds promising—I’ll swing by the community center after errands, so just tell me what still needs covering once you’ve got the count straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I sign on, can you confirm exactly who’s bringing the tools and where everything’s being stored?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have the full tool list yet, but Leo said he can sort tools and do a pickup run if needed, and everything’s meeting at the community center. Once Noah finishes the count, I can confirm what’s actually being brought and what still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo—if you’re sorting the repair drive schedule, I can do Saturday from 9:30 to 1:30 between school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works great, Faye—I'll put you down for Saturday 9:30 to 1:30 at the repair drive table.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Leo—that window works best for me with the school run.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m helping with the repair drive by sorting the donated tools first and setting aside anything missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s useful, Sam, but I still need the full tool list and the storage spot confirmed before I can commit to helping.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m on the tool sorting now, Pia, but Leo still needs to confirm the storage spot; once that’s set, I can pass along the full tool list plain and simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s coming along pretty well, Vik—we’ve got a decent little list of fixes lined up already, though I still need to double-check whether we’re starting at eight or nine.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling everyone the updated plan is Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot, Oren, so that’s what I’d go with for now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—good, thanks, Vik; I’m glad you’ve got the clearer version, so let’s stick with Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late again, Eli, but I do remember Vik saying it’s at the community center at nine for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane, but I’m not settling on nine yet—Pia heard ten, so I need the start time confirmed and the drop-off spots listed plain and simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, sorry—I only heard Vik keep saying nine at the community center, and I don’t have the drop-off spots straight, so we should confirm both before we tell folks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be at the repair drive table by 9 with the drill and ladders, and I’m ready to help wherever the safety fixes need me first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus—I only heard bits and pieces, but Rosa’s organizing it and it starts Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know—I'll still get there at 9 with the drill and ladders so I can get set up before things start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I answer anything, can you confirm whether we’re still prioritizing only safety-related repairs like space heaters and lamps for this first pass?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think so, yeah—safety stuff first for this pass, like heaters and lamps, unless Quinn said otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—can you also confirm whether we’re still counting sign-ups from just the online form and not the paper list before I note anything down?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right now I’ve got extension cords and work gloves at the top of the list, and I’m planning to compare my notes with Jules’s tomorrow to see what else we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—that helps a lot, and I’ll keep spreading the word for Saturday morning at the community center so folks can bring cords, gloves, or anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—that should help a lot, and once I compare notes with Jules tomorrow I’ll let you know if there’s anything else we should ask people to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly small fixes so far—lamps, toasters, a bike brake, and a couple torn jackets. Cleo’s tracking parts too, and Gus said he can bring his drill, ladders, and a basic toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve got those logged for the community center lot, and I’m still noting the repair drive as around 10-ish this weekend unless someone confirms a firmer start time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. Once Cleo confirms the supplies list and we lock down the storage spot, I can give Pia the clear rundown she asked for.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa, I’ll come by Saturday and bring a little for the repair drive—sorry it can’t be more right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s very kind, Uli—thank you. Just so you have the latest, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and whatever you can bring will help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for letting me know, Rosa. I’ll stop by Sunday at the community center and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still interested, Mara, but I need the tool list and the storage spot confirmed before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s fair, Pia—I’m confirming the storage spot now, and I’ll send you the tool list with the safety repairs first so you can decide.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara—that helps. Once you’ve confirmed the storage spot and sent the tool list, I can decide.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard it’s mostly small fixes so far, and Gus said he can bring a drill and a couple ladders. I’m still trying to pin down the rest of the tools and where we’ll store everything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling everyone it’s Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot, so that’s where we should have folks bring the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, that helps—I’ll let Pia know the tools can go to the community garden lot on Saturday at 10, and I’ll keep asking around about who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say anything, can you confirm whether Jules wants the sign-up count from just the online form, or from the paper list too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Both, if you can—Rosa’s got Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot, and I’m trying to see the full headcount across every circle.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—before I give a number, can you check with Rosa so we’ve got the online form and paper list counted together accurately?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, last I heard they’re still eyeing Saturday morning for the repair drive, though Marcy said it might slip a touch—still, folks seem ready to show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ve got Saturday at 9 in my head for now, and I’m bringing my toolkit and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect, Bo—having your toolkit and those cords there will help a ton. If I hear anything firmer from Marcy, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please bring all three, and once Cleo checks the sign-up count I’ll figure out how many cords and gloves we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll be there at 9 with the drill, ladders, and stud finder, and I’ll bring them to the repair drive table.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect—once you arrive, check in at the repair drive table and I’ll slot you where the ladder and drill are needed most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal—I'm organizing the repair drive, and the latest update is that it’s Sunday at the community center. If you’re joining, I can tell you what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—I’ve got the repair drive noted at the community center, and I still have us penciled in for around 10-ish there. Tell me what to bring, and I’ll keep the location notes straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that location is right, and let’s plan to start at 10 on Sunday at the community center. If you can, bring work gloves and any basic tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can chip in a little for the repair drive, Noah—just not much right now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That still helps, Uli—thanks. It’s at the community shed at ten this Saturday, if you can make it by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll stop by Saturday and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, the repair drive’s this Saturday at the community shed starting at 10—come by if you can, and feel free to send anyone else along too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—10 should work if my errands don’t run long, so I’ll swing by when I can and help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, we’d love the help—drop in whenever you can, and if anyone else mentions they’re handy, send them over too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s shaping up pretty well—we’ve got the fence latch, Mrs. Alvarez’s porch step, and that busted bike tire on the list, and unless I’ve muddled it again, it’s 10-ish at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That all sounds good, Oren—I’m still sorting the donated tools now, and I’ll treat 10-ish at the community center lot as tentative until Leo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good—thanks, Sam. Yes, please treat it as tentative; I’d rather not muddle the time again before Leo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on extension cords and work gloves, and I want to keep lamp parts near the top too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help Saturday from 9:30 to 1:30 between school drop-off and pickup, so put me wherever that’s most useful—extension cords, gloves, or lamp parts all sound fine.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s a big help, Faye—Saturday you’d be great on supply check-in and keeping extension cords, gloves, and lamp parts organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Leo, before I commit, can you confirm exactly who’s bringing the tools and where everything’s being stored?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus is bringing everything to the repair drive table around 9, and I’ll get it lined up there when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that for sure, Leo, and that the tools are being stored at the repair drive table once Gus gets there?
